title: Spiral Stitch round a hole: ring40-hole10, round 7
description: PE-DESIGN 11.50's Spiral Stitch round a hole, round 7: a spiral from the outline inwards and one round the hole. PE: PE sews the outline's spiral inwards to the middle of the band, then the band where the two spirals meet as separate trimmed pieces (each with a tie-in and a lock), then the hole's spiral: 15 band pieces at r 12.2-12.7 mm, alternating 7-needle 17° runs with longer ones; 32 trims. OpenStitch joins its two spirals with one travel and does not sew the band pieces. Open, pinned at the internal tier: stitches (PE 1917, OpenStitch 1557).

references.make: a 40 mm Circle (30,30)-(70,70) with a 10 mm Circle (45,45)-(55,55) as hole (Set hole sewing, inner region Not Sewn); region Spiral Stitch on the outer shape. Hoop 100 x 100 mm page; line Not Sewn (Line); colour 800 EMBROIDERY RED; region attributes at their defaults (Density 2,0 line/mm, Run pitch 2,0 mm, Start Point first button) unless stated; nothing else in the design. Save As PES (default type, #PES0110). Status bar 39,30 x 39,70 mm, 1917 st.

measurements.evidence: KNOWN DIFFERENCE (open): PE-DESIGN 11.50's file measures 1917, OpenStitch 1557; this check pins OpenStitch's value until the rule is found: PE sews the band where its outline and hole spirals meet as separate trimmed sliver pieces, the gaps its own turn sampling leaves; OpenStitch joins the spirals with one travel because that sampling rule is not known yet (COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT, Concentric Circle and Spiral).
